title: Frame captures at 30000ms and 90000ms but no 60000ms — midpoint of the 90s run is absent
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png
+logic_hz 20
+ticks 1800
detail: Sim spans 90s (1800 ticks @ 20hz). Captures exist at 30s and 90s only; if frames are meant at 30s intervals, the 60s frame was skipped or the cadence is undocumented in this diff.
recommended_fix: Add goldens/dublin_board/60000ms.png, or document why captures occur only at 30s and 90s.

title: Golden files split across two layout conventions: demo-prefixed names at goldens/ root vs per-demo subdirectory
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board.log.bin b/goldens/dublin_board.log.bin
diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board.t1 b/goldens/dublin_board.t1
diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png
detail: log.bin and .t1 live at goldens/ root with a dublin_board filename prefix, while PNGs live under goldens/dublin_board/. Two organizational schemes in one changeset invite path-handling mistakes.
recommended_fix: Pick one convention — e.g. move dublin_board.log.bin and dublin_board.t1 into goldens/dublin_board/ — and use it for all artifacts of a run.
